mapper.select: /* 카테고리별/상세스펙 사용유무 필터링 */ SELECT spec_no AS specNo, spec_nm AS specName FROM products_spec WHERE use_status = '사용중' ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(spec_no, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED);

/* 모델 사용유무 필터링 */ SELECT m.model_no AS modelNo, m.model_nm AS modelName, m.product_category_no AS categoryNo, i.item_nm AS itemName FROM model m inner join item i on m.item_no = i.item_no WHERE m.use_status = '사용중' ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(model_no, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED);
/* 품목 사용유무 필터링 */ SELECT item_no AS itemNo, item_nm AS itemName FROM item WHERE use_status = '사용중' ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(item_no, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED);
/* 브랜드 사용유무 필터링 */ SELECT brand_no AS brandNo, brand_nm AS brandName FROM brand WHERE use_status = '사용중' ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(brand_no, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED);

/* 카테고리 사용유무 필터링 */ SELECT product_category_no AS categoryNo, large_category AS lgCategory, middle_category AS mdCategory, small_category AS smCategory, use_status AS useStatus FROM products_category WHERE use_status = '사용중' ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(product_category_no, '_', 1), 'L', -1) AS UNSIGNED), CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(product_category_no, '_', 2), 'M', -1) AS UNSIGNED), CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(product_category_no, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED);

/* 카테고리코드로 등록된 품목 조회 */ SELECT count(*) FROM item WHERE product_category_no = #{categoryNo}

mapper.insert:
/* 스펙내용코드 자동증가 */ SELECT case when count(*) = 0 then 'spec_content_1' else CONCAT('spec_content_',max(cast(SUBSTRING_INDEX(spec_content_no, '_', -1) as unsigned))+1) end as modelSpecNo FROM model_spec_content;
/* 모델별/상세스펙 등록 */ INSERT INTO model_spec_content (spec_content_no, manager_id, model_no, spec_no, spec_content, register_date, revision_date, use_status) VALUES (#{modelSpecNo}, #{managerId}, #{modelNo}, #{specNo}, #{modelSpecName}, NOW(), NOW(), '사용중');

/* 스펙코드 자동증가 */ SELECT case when count(*) = 0 then 'spec_1' else CONCAT('spec_',max(cast(SUBSTRING_INDEX(spec_no, '_', -1) as unsigned))+1) end as specNo FROM products_spec;
/* 카테고리별/상세스펙 등록 */ INSERT INTO products_spec (spec_no, manager_id, product_category_no, spec_nm, register_date, revision_date, use_status) VALUES (#{specNo}, #{managerId}, #{categoryNo}, #{specName}, NOW(), NOW(), '사용중');

/* 혜택코드 자동증가 */ SELECT case when count(*) = 0 then 'benefit_1' else CONCAT('benefit_',max(cast(SUBSTRING_INDEX(benefit_no, '_', -1) as unsigned))+1) end as benefitNo FROM benefit;
/* 전체혜택 등록 */ INSERT INTO benefit (benefit_no, manager_id, benefit_nm, register_date, revision_date, use_status) VALUES (#{benefitNo}, #{managerId}, #{benefitName}, NOW(), NOW(), '사용중');

/* 모델코드 자동증가 */ SELECT case when count(*) = 0 then 'model_1' else CONCAT('model_',max(cast(SUBSTRING_INDEX(model_no, '_', -1) as unsigned))+1) end as modelNo FROM model;
/* 모델 등록 */ INSERT INTO model (model_no, manager_id, brand_no, item_no, product_category_no, model_nm, register_date, revision_date, use_status) VALUES (#{modelNo}, #{managerId}, #{brandNo}, #{itemNo}, #{categoryNo}, #{modelName}, NOW(), NOW(), '사용중');

/* 품목코드 자동증가 */ SELECT case when count(*) = 0 then 'item_1' else CONCAT('item_',max(cast(SUBSTRING_INDEX(item_no, '_', -1) as unsigned))+1) end as itemNo FROM item;
/* 품목 등록 */ INSERT INTO item (item_no, manager_id, product_category_no, item_nm, register_date, revision_date, use_status) VALUES (#{itemNo}, #{managerId}, #{categoryNo}, #{itemName}, NOW(), NOW(), '사용중');

/* 브랜드코드 자동증가 */ SELECT case when count(*) = 0 then 'brand_1' else CONCAT('brand_',max(cast(SUBSTRING_INDEX(brand_no, '_', -1) as unsigned))+1) end as brandNo FROM brand;
/* 브랜드 등록 */ INSERT INTO brand (brand_no, manager_id, brand_nm, register_date, revision_date, use_status) VALUES (#{brandNo}, #{managerId}, #{brandName}, NOW(), NOW(), '사용중');

/* 카테고리코드 자동증가 */ SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN CONCAT(#{lgCategoryNo}, '_', #{mdCategoryNo}, '_1') -- 최초에는 1번 ELSE CONCAT(#{lgCategoryNo}, '_', #{mdCategoryNo}, '_', MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(product_category_no, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED)) + 1) -- 기존 값들 중에서 최대값 + 1 END AS product_category_no FROM products_category WHERE large_category_no = #{lgCategoryNo} AND middle_category_no = #{mdCategoryNo}
/* 카테고리 등록 */ INSERT INTO products_category (product_category_no, manager_id, large_category_no, large_category, middle_category_no, middle_category, small_category, register_date, revision_date, use_status) VALUES (#{categoryNo}, #{managerId}, #{lgCategoryNo}, #{lgCategory}, #{mdCategoryNo}, #{mdCategory}, #{smCategory}, NOW(), NOW(), '사용중');
mapper.select: /* 모델별/상세스펙 목록 조회*/ SELECT msc.spec_content_no, msc.manager_id, m.model_nm, ps.spec_nm, msc.spec_content, msc.register_date, msc.revision_date, msc.use_status FROM model_spec_content msc inner join model m on msc.MODEL_NO = m.MODEL_NO inner join products_spec ps using(spec_no) ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(spec_content_no, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED);

/* 카테고리별/상세스펙 목록 조회 */ SELECT ps.spec_no, ps.manager_id, pc.small_category, ps.spec_nm, ps.register_date, ps.revision_date, ps.use_status FROM products_spec ps inner join products_category pc using(product_category_no) ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(spec_no, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED);
/* 전체혜택 목록 조회 */ SELECT benefit_no, manager_id, benefit_nm, register_date, revision_date, use_status FROM benefit ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(benefit_no, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED);

/* 모델 목록 조회 */ SELECT m.model_no, m.manager_id, b.brand_nm, i.item_nm, pc.small_category, m.model_nm, m.register_date, m.revision_date, m.use_status FROM model m inner join products_category pc using(product_category_no) inner join item i using(item_no) left join brand b using(brand_no) ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(model_no, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED);

/* 품목 목록 조회 */ SELECT i.item_no, i.manager_id, pc.small_category, i.item_nm, i.register_date, i.revision_date, i.use_status FROM item i inner join products_category pc using(product_category_no) ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(item_no, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED);
/* 브랜드 목록 조회 */ SELECT brand_no, manager_id, brand_nm, register_date, revision_date, use_status FROM brand ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(brand_no, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED);

/* 카테고리 목록 조회 */ SELECT product_category_no, manager_id, large_category_no, large_category, middle_category_no, middle_category, small_category, register_date, revision_date, use_status FROM products_category ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(product_category_no, '_', 1), 'L', -1) AS UNSIGNED), CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(product_category_no, '_', 2), 'M', -1) AS UNSIGNED), CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(product_category_no, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED);
SELECT product_category_no, small_category FROM products_category WHERE use_status = '사용중' AND middle_category_no = #{mdCategoryNo};
